summary: Develop a small ML operation from a mathematical contract to a verified GPU implementation before framework packaging.
outcomes: Implement a complete ML operation with explicit shape/dtype semantics.
Compare correctness and performance with the framework reference.
sequence: Choose a bounded normalization or fused transform.
Work a tiny example and define edge cases.
Assign thread ownership and intermediate reductions.
Implement with explicit error and numerical checks.
Profile realistic shapes and decide whether custom code is justified.
